$comment: Synthetic. Shared cases for the two evaluators of plugin rules (the web UI and the reference evaluator). registry.json in this directory is the registry (contract StudioPluginList) every case is evaluated against; a case with "registry": "unavailable" is evaluated without one. Input: plugins (the project's prompt_plugins), prompt. expect: problems (references that cannot be used), forbidden and missing (prompt rules; a finding of a per-shot check also names its shot, and a subject that no shot names its subject), the prompt to send, and blocked. These files are ASCII: every other character is written as a JSON Unicode escape, so that a reader sees which character a case is about. tools/contracts/sync_studio_plugins.py --check verifies every case with the reference evaluator.
